before.title: Characterisation of mechanical properties of materials used in 3D printing
claim_notes: Attribution: Aniskevich Andrey and Bulderberga Olga (2023), Characterisation of mechanical properties of materials used in 3D printing, Zenodo dataset, version DOI 10.5281/zenodo.8089569; concept DOI 10.5281/zenodo.8089568. Creator order and spelling follow the Zenodo version record.

Annex 3.1. Characterisation of mechanical properties.xlsx: 1391320 bytes; published MD5 c4842898d2c389ccd7a902691d8a4fa3; independently computed SHA-256 830b2c9277dcc2d03265b63e311a5e7089c258ebb6a389b45d07601ae4b2e4e7.

Selected reference-filament tensile measurements,geometric reference-filament densities,and selected extruded-fiber/dogbone tensile measurements are curated as separate test contexts. Numeric XML lexical values are preserved without recalculation. The raw workbook,images,full worksheets and extensive prose remain excluded.

The measured E:H reference-filament headers report data from 10 mm/min tests, whereas the Samples worksheet TextBox 3 reference-filament paragraph reports 1 mm/min on a ZWICK 2.5. Both statements are retained; the actual per-row rate is unresolved. The reference-column ISO 527-2 label and the separate dogbone protocol are not transferred to reference-filament records.

Samples C27 states that three to five specimens were tested per series and average data were used. Exact row-specific n is unstated. The avedev columns are retained as source-labelled deviations without assuming SD, SE, confidence intervals or a defined calculation.

Zenodo version metadata.license.id and DataCite concept rightsList independently report CC BY 4.0; DataCite HasVersion identifies 10.5281/zenodo.8089569. Attribution, source/version links and license link are retained. Catalog organization and original qualification notes are adaptations; no source endorsement or relicensing under the project MIT license is asserted. Manufacturer evidence has its own rights scope.

2026-11-03 follow-up inspected worksheet-linked DrawingML text omitted by the earlier cell-only extraction: reference-filament nominal length approximately140mm, initial grip separation100mm and modulus fitting over0.05–0.25% strain are now qualified source-method evidence. Fitting algorithm, temperature, humidity, conditioning, exact row-specific n and avedev definition remain unknown. No external workbook links or formulas were executed or refreshed.

2026-11-11 existing-series expansion: J:M single-fiber extrusion and O:R/T:W source-labelled0/90 dogbone tensile cells remain separate from E:H reference-filament data. SamplesC27 supports3–5 specimens per tensile series and averages,not exact group n;Density drawing5 three-specimen average is density-only. Preserve source0/90 labels without assigning raster/build/load axes,avedev numbers without SD interpretation,and separate form-specific speeds and strain channels. Reference-filament1vs10mm/min conflict remains unresolved. No new material identity,external-link/formula execution or scientific certification.

provenance.method: Official Zenodo version metadata and DataCite concept metadata checked; one bounded workbook download independently matched the published size and MD5. Original worksheet cells and XML numeric storage were inspected without formula execution, raw-data reanalysis, new experiments or independent scientific approval. Follow-up re-acquired the same hash-bound workbook and inspected Samples-linked DrawingML text and its reference-filament section separately from the thin-fiber and dogbone sections. Header/method speed disagreement is explicitly retained; prior selected-cell inspection remains historical.
